RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications are strong, but a leadership appointment may prioritize management, regulatory expertise, or interview performance; the announcement doesn’t establish her full qualifications.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your experience was assessed, and feedback on why you weren’t selected. The silence warrants chasing, not an inference of discrimination.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or demonstrably unequal treatment—not simply the panel’s composition. If you’re considering a formal challenge, check local deadlines promptly. A numerical probability here would be invented.
